title: The Dove and the Ant
text:
On a hot day an ant went down to a spring to drink. As it leaned over the edge, it slipped and fell into the water. The current carried it away, and the little creature struggled hopelessly to keep from drowning.

A dove was sitting on a branch above the stream and saw what was happening. She broke off a leaf with her beak and let it fall onto the water just beside the ant. The ant climbed onto the leaf, floated safely to the bank and crawled out onto dry ground.

Not long afterward a bird catcher came to the spot. He saw the dove resting in the tree and quietly began to set up his snare, or in some versions to raise his limed rods, to catch her. The dove had no idea she was in danger.

But the ant had seen him. It ran up and bit him hard on the foot. The man cried out in pain and jerked, his trap was spoiled, and the noise warned the dove, who flew away to safety.
lesson: Small kindnesses are worth doing even when you expect nothing back. Help travels in both directions, often from people you thought could never return it.
